reason: The indexing strongly supports the 5.47410 x 5.53849 x 8.06429 A, 244.5 A^3 cell and is consistent with Z = 2 and a distorted double-perovskite framework; the reported Ni-O and Ru-O distances are also plausible. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trace reports only a custom profile residual (about 0.0696) from a heavily constrained model. It compared Sr/Nd permutations, an averaged A-site model, Pnma trials, and a global swap within one fixed rock-salt Ni/Ru motif, but did not instantiate and compare materially distinct B-site orderings or broad competing low-symmetry periodic models. Pc was assigned post hoc from the chosen constrained coordinates rather than established by a symmetry/model comparison, and the oxygen coordinates and exact cation realization therefore remain underdetermined. Another scientifically motivated attempt is warranted.
